arguments.command:
python -c "
from funcy import get_spec, autocurry, rcurry, rpartial

def f(a, b, *, c):
    return a, b, c

spec = get_spec(f)
print('spec:', spec)
print('required_names:', spec[0])
print('required_n:', spec[1])
print('max_n:', spec[2])

# Try autocurry
af = autocurry(f)
print('af(1)(2)(c=3):', af(1)(2)(c=3))
"
